checks: Mixamo: public search shows 51 Great Sword motions, including all six exact descriptions above. Public thumbnails are available; account/download steps are reserved for you. The existing local sword-and-shield pack is not treated as a two-handed source.

Fab: Epic Kwang and Greystone are currently free. Kwang is shortlisted for sword motion; Greystone is not assumed to supply two-handed heavies. Ailive Greatsword Animation Pack is paid on the live page and excluded. No Add to Library, cart or login action was taken.

CC0 pass: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 2 has a free Standard tier and a paid Source tier. The advertised 130+ total is not a verified free inventory. Two-handed fit and a free aerial attack were not established, so the entire pack is not presented as a verified solution.
NVIDIA SimReady: the checked dataset is simulation-ready USD props, with CC-BY-4.0 terms. No matching humanoid sword motion was established.

ThreeJS Assets: the checked free catalogue emphasizes environment/object assets; no matching two-handed attack motion was established. A later page fetch timed out, so this is a limited catalogue check, not proof the site has none.
Wider free sources: Kevin Iglesias explicitly lists a two-handed attack in the free package. Cornettolo Greatsword User Animations is a 2D sprite sheet and cannot be retargeted to this knight.

All choices are source candidates. None has been newly downloaded, retargeted, fitted, integrated or quality-approved in Veyr. Preview media stays at the original provider; this page does not mirror raw assets.
